sloka: माल्यवांश्च सुमाली च माली च सुमहाबलाः ।आसन्पुरःसरास्तेषां क्रतूनामिव पावकाः ।। ७.६.५९ ॥
transliteration: mālyavāṁśca sumālī ca mālī ca sumahābalāḥ ।āsanpuraḥsarāsteṣāṁ kratūnāmiva pāvakāḥ ।। 7.6.59 ॥

translations.english: All those night-wandering demons indeed took refuge in Malyavan, just as gods resort to Brahma, and as one would take refuge in an unmoving mountain.
